# GitHub social preview

Repo Open Graph / Twitter cards for the **website** use `web/public/og.png` via Next metadata (`web/app/layout.tsx`).

For the **GitHub repository** social image (shown on github.com/mohabdelkarim/citefolio):

1. Open **Settings → General → Social preview**
2. Upload `web/public/og.png` (1200×630, bone / ink / ink-red)

GitHub does not set this file from the repo automatically.
